name: Papillion
seo_title: Papillion Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 5 Events, 1 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Papillion, Nebraska for 2026: Winter Wonderland, Santa's Rock n' Lights, Storytime with Santa and nearby Gretna events.
lede: Papillion kicks off Christmas with a downtown Winter Wonderland, then keeps the lights on with a drive-thru show at Werner Park.
celebrates: Papillion starts the season with a Christmas parade and tree lighting at Shadow Lake Towne Center, followed by Winter Wonderland downtown, where the Papillion Community Foundation lists Santa, live reindeer, carriage rides and a Christkindl Holiday Market. The foundation says more than 800,000 lights come on across downtown. Santa's Rock n' Lights opens at Werner Park in late November, and Sump Memorial Library brings Santa to a December storytime. Because Gretna has fewer than three verified events, its holiday event and its Santa visit at Nebraska Crossing are listed on this page too.
lastyear: The city held its 19th annual Christmas parade and tree lighting on November 21, 2026, and WOWT reported that rain did not stop families from lining the streets of Shadow Lake Towne Center for the parade, fireworks and Santa. A Home Team blog post describes the 2026 Winter Wonderland as returning after last year's snow-out. The foundation also lists a Magic Pass drawing for a front-row lighting ceremony.
facts: The Papillion Community Foundation calls Winter Wonderland a tradition in which 800,000 lights light up downtown, and says Papillion is an official Hallmark Christmas Town for 2026. Santa's Rock n' Lights describes itself as Omaha's longest-running drive-thru light show, with nearly 2 miles of lights synchronized to music on 90.3 FM at Werner Park. The Christkindl Holiday Market is brought to the event by Jensen Gardens, according to the foundation.
trains: We did not find a Papillion train ride. The Durham Museum in Omaha's Union Station hosts Christmas at Union Station, and Amtrak's California Zephyr stops at the Omaha station at 1003 South 9th Street, according to Amtrak. The Fremont and Elkhorn Valley Railroad in Fremont is the nearest heritage railroad. The Polar Express train at Falconwood Frosty Nights in nearby Bellevue is included with admission, according to the park.

faq: Papillion holds a Christmas parade and tree lighting in November and Winter Wonderland downtown on the last Saturday of November, with Santa, live reindeer and carriage rides. Santa's Rock n' Lights runs a drive-thru show at Werner Park into January.
Is Winter Wonderland in Papillion free?
Yes. The Papillion Community Foundation says rides, Santa and hot chocolate are free for everyone, and you bring cash or cards for the Christkindl Market.
Where can kids meet Santa in Papillion?
At Winter Wonderland in the Historic Portal Schoolhouse on November 28, and at Storytime with Santa at Sump Memorial Library on December 16.
How do I see Santa's Rock n' Lights?
Buy a time slot online. The ticket is per carload, there are no on-site sales and you tune your radio to 90.3 FM.
Which Gretna events are listed here?
Greenery and Glitter on December 6 and the Santa visit at Nebraska Crossing on November 27 and 28 are listed on this page because Gretna has fewer than three verified events.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Papillion for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 26 (Santa's Rock n' Lights at Werner Park, which runs through January 2, 2027) to December 16 (Storytime with Santa at Sump Memorial Library), with Winter Wonderland (November 28), Greenery and Glitter in nearby Gretna (December 6) and a Santa visit at Nebraska Crossing (November 27 and 28) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Papillion

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in Papillion, including 2 from nearby Gretna

  • Meet Santa: Winter Wonderland (November 28), Storytime with Santa (December 16) and Nebraska Crossing (November 27 and 28)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Winter Wonderland lighting ceremony (November 28) and Gretna's tree lighting (December 6)

  • Season: November 26 to January 2, 2027
